meta.description: Portfolio of Faris Zain As-Shadiq, a full-stack web developer and Informatics undergraduate at Universitas Syiah Kuala, Banda Aceh. Machine learning when the product needs it.

hero.name: Faris Zain
hero.tagline: Full-stack web developer. ML when it's needed.

about.label: About
about.lead: I'm an Informatics undergraduate at Universitas Syiah Kuala who builds full-stack web applications with Next.js, TypeScript and Python.
about.body: So far: a CSIRT website delivered to Badan Pengelola Migas Aceh, a WebGIS module inside the university's disaster-response portal, and MosqRisk, a dengue early-warning platform that is live. Machine learning comes in when the product needs it, not before.

steps.title: Research
steps.text: Start with the problem: who uses it, what data exists, and what has to work first.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Flows and interface in Figma, then the data structure and API, before any code.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Frontend and backend together, in small pieces that can be tried right away.

steps.title: Ship
steps.text: Deploy early, show progress regularly, and fix what the feedback finds.
